messages.subject: BAFS | Aviation energy, sustainability and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear BAFS Leadership Team,

BAFS operates where aviation, energy infrastructure and public-sector coordination meet. That intersection closely matches my experience.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy. I also work with civil aviation authorities as part of remote-site operating requirements.

My recent work includes governance around renewable energy, battery storage and carbon-data readiness, alongside complex regulator and community coordination. I would bring BAFS an executive perspective connecting infrastructure reliability with sustainability and institutional trust.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a BAFS-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
